title: Calendly Standard to self-hosted Easy!Appointments
summary: The lightest scheduling swap here — a PHP app on a $6 box. The trade is that it looks and feels like one.

you_lose: Calendly's polish, which matters because your customers see this page, not you
Deep calendar sync; Google works, everything else is thinner
Routing forms, workflows and reminders beyond the basics
you_gain: A LAMP app that runs on the smallest box sold and asks almost nothing of you
Free seats, which is the entire argument past a couple of users

caveats: This is the booking page your customers land on. If it looks dated, that cost does not appear anywhere in the arithmetic below and may still be the deciding factor.
If you want a like-for-like Calendly replacement, read the Cal.com page instead — closer product, heavier server.
Timezone handling has historically been the rough edge. Test it against a customer in another country before you switch.
